prompt: The client asks: "Should the hospital build a new surgical wing?" Fact sheet: the wing costs $120M and adds 8 operating rooms; current operating rooms run at 95% with a 6-week waitlist; each operating room earns about $3M a year in profit; the hurdle is a 7-year payback; the hospital won a quality award in 2024. Which is the best recommendation?

options.text: Build the surgical wing. The current rooms run at 95% with a 6-week waitlist, and 8 new rooms earning about $3M each pay back the $120M in 5 years, inside the 7-year hurdle. The main risk is that the waitlist doesn't fill all 8 rooms, so the next step is to check how many of the 8 rooms the waitlist would fill in year one.
options.feedback: Right. It leads with the answer, backs it with the numbers that matter, and gives a risk and a next step.
